method.sweep: 33 points per numeric input over its declared range (logarithmic when it spans 30× or more), the others at their defaults; 6 s per instrument, 20 s hard stop
method.laws: a form names a curve only if it reproduces every point to 1e-9 of its range; forms are linear in their coefficients after a change of variable and are tried from the fewest coefficients up
method.rational: p within 1e-7 of a/b with b ≤ 12 for a pure power; b ≤ 6, |p| ≤ 8 for an offset power
method.shape: 48-point fingerprint on the unit square of a curve no form names; correlation ≥ 0.99999 under the four reflections; it must bend (≥ 0.08 from its chord) and not jump (no step over a third of its range); families by single linkage
method.constants: api/invariants.json named closed forms that are irrational (a surd, φ, π, a logarithm …) — integers and plain fractions coincide too easily to bind anything
method.weight: a class shared by k laboratories gives each of its pairs 1/(k − 1); a bridge weighs 1
method.scope: each bridge tie re-tested with every other numeric input of both laboratories moved to three seeded settings in its range: universal (same law, same constant), form (same law, constant moves), defaults (law breaks somewhere), untested
method.bridge: two laboratories with the same physical input (name and unit; counters, seeds and generic symbols left out) swept together over the overlap of their ranges; an exact tie y_B = a + b·y_A or y_B = k·y_A^q (q rational) to 1e-9, not implied by both being powers or straight lines in the input; the constant named as r·π^a·√s when it is one to 1e-9
method.validation: declared = the atlas’s typed relations join the two laboratories; hypergeometric tail of catching that many declared pairs by chance; strong = pairs bound with weight ≥ 1/3
method.topology: Adamic–Adar on the declared graph; a candidate’s value is the share of undeclared pairs it outranks; the score’s own AUC by leaving each declared edge out
method.communities: greedy modularity on the detected graph; NMI against the worlds and categories the atlas assigns
method.layout: eigenvectors 2–4 of the normalised Laplacian of declared (½) ∪ detected, with a weak uniform coupling 0.02/n, radii by rank, then 400 cooling steps of a 3D Fruchterman–Reingold layout with the same weights and a gravity n·k²·x that holds the unconnected in

claim_classes.scope: EXACT_COMPUTATION here means: exact to 1e-9 on the swept range with the other inputs at their defaults — not a proof off that range; NUMERIC: agreement of sampled shapes only
claim_classes.unresolved: an analytic argument that a tie holds off the swept range and at other settings of the other inputs
